notes: Old height/weight/BMI block was the template copy (F162/66/25.3, M174/78/25.9) - implausible for a majority-Inuit population.

Derived from measured data in the Greenland Population Health Survey 2018 (B2018, n=2436 Inuit, objectively measured; published in Int J Circumpolar Health): adults 15-54 mean height 165.0 cm / weight 73.6 kg / BMI 26.9; adults 55+ mean 158.9 cm / 70.2 kg / BMI 27.5 (both sexes combined). Population-weighted adult average ~163-164 cm / ~73 kg / BMI ~27.

Sexed split derived using the standard Inuit sexual-dimorphism gap (~12 cm height, ~10 kg weight), giving F158 cm / 68 kg and M170 cm / 78 kg; both sexes then land at BMI 27, consistent with the published median BMI of 26.1 in the B2018 obesity-trends study and the high measured obesity prevalence (F29.6%/M22.2%, already stored). Marked as derived - no sexed mean-height table is published for Greenland.
obesityRate/smokingRate left unchanged: already real territory data from B2018 / Bjerregaard & Larsen 2018 (fixed in repair_health_1).

Height/weight/BMI were template copies (F162/66/25.3, M174/78/25.9) inconsistent with Guam's documented 35% adult obesity. No territory-level mean height or mean BMI is published for Guam (BRFSS publishes only prevalence; checked CDC BRFSS Prevalence & Trends and World Obesity Observatory country profile).

Derived per ladder rule from the verified US anchor block (F163cm/74kg/BMI28, M176cm/89kg/BMI28.7): Guam's adult obesity prevalence (BRFSS 2023: 35.4%) sits at essentially the same level as the current US national rate (~37%), so the anchor anthropometry is applied unchanged as the closest comparable population.
femaleObesityRate/maleObesityRate/obesityRate (35.4) and smoking rates (F17.0/M19.1/18.0) left unchanged: already real CDC BRFSS 2023 Guam crude prevalence (set in repair_health_2).
